selection: Definitions, training syntheses, cognitive mechanisms, constraints, social exchange, selection, measurement and AI diversity; primary publications or their publisher/author/institutional records.
evidence_transfer: Human studies, observational findings, theory and agent-workflow hypotheses remain separate.

sources.authors: Runco, M. A., & Jaeger, G. J.
sources.title: The Standard Definition of Creativity
sources.read_scope: publisher metadata and original article text via PDF
sources.supported_claim: Originality and effectiveness are separate requirements under the standard definition.
sources.claim_limit: Does not identify a sufficient causal recipe for producing creativity.

sources.authors: Kaufman, J. C., & Beghetto, R. A.
sources.title: Beyond Big and Little: The Four C Model of Creativity
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Distinguishes mini-c, little-c, Pro-c and Big-C.
sources.claim_limit: Developmental categories are not evidence that one intervention produces eminent creativity.

sources.authors: Boden, M. A.
sources.title: Computer Models of Creativity
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and targeted original PDF passages
sources.supported_claim: Distinguishes combinational, exploratory and transformational creativity; psychological versus historical novelty.
sources.claim_limit: Taxonomy does not establish comparative efficacy of the proposed workflows.

sources.authors: Amabile, T. M.
sources.title: Componential Theory of Creativity
sources.venue: Harvard Business School Working Paper 12-096; prepared for Encyclopedia of Management Theory
sources.evidence_type: theory summary in a working paper
sources.read_scope: original PDF: abstract, fundamentals and components
sources.supported_claim: Domain skills, creativity-relevant processes, task motivation and environment interact in the theory.
sources.claim_limit: Its stated necessary components belong to a theory, not a universal experimentally established checklist.

sources.authors: Amabile, T. M., & Pratt, M. G.
sources.title: The dynamic componential model of creativity and innovation in organizations: Making progress, making meaning
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and introduction
sources.supported_claim: Adds progress, meaningfulness, affect and synergistic extrinsic motivation to the organizational model.
sources.claim_limit: Does not imply all external rewards suppress creativity or that agents possess human motivation.

sources.authors: Scott, G., Leritz, L. E., & Mumford, M. D.
sources.title: The effectiveness of creativity training: A quantitative review
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Review of 70 studies associated stronger programs with cognitive skills, heuristics and realistic domain exercises.
sources.claim_limit: Historical synthesis should be read alongside newer publication-bias and quality findings.

sources.authors: Sio, U. N., & Lortie-Forgues, H.
sources.title: The impact of creativity training on creative performance: A meta-analytic review and critical evaluation of 5 decades of creativity training studies
sources.read_scope: institutional abstract and targeted accepted-manuscript passages
sources.supported_claim: 169 studies, 844 effects: unadjusted 0.53 SD; adjusted estimates 0.29–0.32 SD; substantial methodological limitations.
sources.claim_limit: Adjusted estimates are model-dependent; these are measured task effects, not a universal increase in creativity.

sources.authors: Haase, J., Hanel, P. H. P., & Gronau, N.
sources.title: Creativity Enhancement Methods for Adults: A Meta-Analysis
sources.venue: Psychology of Aesthetics, Creativity, and the Arts, 19(4), 708–736; online first 2023
sources.read_scope: institutional abstracts and bibliographic metadata
sources.supported_claim: 332 effects across enhancement methods: g=0.53, 95% CI [0.44, 0.61], substantial variation; no detected publication bias in this analysis.
sources.claim_limit: Corpus, scope and bias analysis differ from A07; the absence of detected bias is not proof of absence.

sources.authors: Finke, R. A., Ward, T. B., & Smith, S. M.
sources.title: Creative Cognition: Theory, Research, and Applications
sources.read_scope: publisher description; Geneplore process also checked in A12 original article
sources.supported_claim: Generation and exploration of provisional structures form a cognitive account of creative construction.
sources.claim_limit: Entire book was not reviewed; new card procedures are inferred adaptations.

sources.authors: Gick, M. L., & Holyoak, K. J.
sources.title: Schema induction and analogical transfer
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Comparing two analogous stories supported schema induction and transfer in the studied tasks.
sources.claim_limit: Surface metaphor or one example with a summary did not reliably reproduce that benefit.

sources.authors: McCaffrey, T.
sources.title: Innovation relies on the obscure: A key to overcoming the classic problem of functional fixedness
sources.read_scope: indexed original abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Generic-parts training improved solution performance on studied functional-fixedness problems.
sources.claim_limit: Reported task-specific gain does not establish universal effectiveness or every aspect of the obscure-features hypothesis.

sources.authors: Smith, S. M., Ward, T. B., & Schumacher, J. S.
sources.title: Constraining effects of examples in a creative generation task
sources.read_scope: author-hosted original article abstract and opening theory sections
sources.supported_claim: Examples induced feature conformity; instructions to differ and a delay did not remove it in these tasks.
sources.claim_limit: Examples can also teach; quarantine is a proposed conditional procedure rather than a ban on examples.

sources.authors: Nijstad, B. A., De Dreu, C. K. W., Rietzschel, E. F., & Baas, M.
sources.title: The dual pathway to creativity model: Creative ideation as a function of flexibility and persistence
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and institutional original PDF excerpt
sources.supported_claim: Original ideas can arise from broad category search and from persistent exploration within categories.
sources.claim_limit: Does not prescribe an optimal breadth/depth allocation or validate renamed multi-agent lanes.

sources.authors: Sio, U. N., & Ormerod, T. C.
sources.title: Does incubation enhance problem solving? A meta-analytic review
sources.read_scope: indexed original abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Incubation effects depend on preparation, task class and intervening activity.
sources.claim_limit: Waiting between stateless agent calls is not evidence of human incubation.

sources.authors: Acar, O. A., Tarakci, M., & van Knippenberg, D.
sources.title: Creativity and Innovation under Constraints: A Cross-Disciplinary Integrative Review
sources.read_scope: institutional abstract and original PDF bibliographic excerpt
sources.supported_claim: Different constraints act through different cognitive, motivational and social mechanisms; results conflict across settings.
sources.claim_limit: Neither more freedom nor more restriction is uniformly better.

sources.authors: Dorst, K., & Cross, N.
sources.title: Creativity in the design process: Co-evolution of problem–solution
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Protocols from nine experienced designers support problem/solution co-evolution as a design account.
sources.claim_limit: Observation does not prove that a prescribed reframing route causes better outcomes.

sources.authors: Nemeth, C. J., Personnaz, B., Personnaz, M., & Goncalo, J. A.
sources.title: The liberating role of conflict in group creativity: A study in two countries
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and targeted 2003 working-paper results
sources.supported_claim: Debate instructions had benefits in the studied groups; not every debate-versus-brainstorming contrast was significant in the working-paper analyses.
sources.claim_limit: Idea quantity and permission to debate do not establish the proposed attack-to-construction protocol or justify hostility.

sources.authors: Stroebe, W., Nijstad, B. A., & Rietzschel, E. F.
sources.title: Beyond Productivity Loss in Brainstorming Groups: The Evolution of a Question
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract via indexed article preview
sources.supported_claim: Production blocking explains substantial interactive-group losses; exchange can also stimulate ideas.
sources.claim_limit: Human turn-taking mechanisms cannot be presumed identical in agent orchestration.

sources.authors: Rietzschel, E. F., Nijstad, B. A., & Stroebe, W.
sources.title: The selection of creative ideas after individual idea generation: Choosing between creativity and impact
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Selection favored feasibility/desirability; originality instructions improved originality while reducing rated effectiveness and satisfaction.
sources.claim_limit: Selecting the strangest candidate is not a sufficient remedy.

sources.authors: Mueller, J. S., Melwani, S., & Goncalo, J. A.
sources.title: The bias against creativity: Why people desire but reject creative ideas
sources.read_scope: indexed original abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Uncertainty manipulations activated anti-creativity bias and impaired recognition in two experiments.
sources.claim_limit: Does not mean every rejection of novelty is bias or that unsafe uncertainty should be increased.

sources.authors: Uzzi, B., Mukherjee, S., Stringer, M., & Jones, B.
sources.title: Atypical combinations and scientific impact
sources.read_scope: indexed original abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Highly cited work tended to combine conventional foundations with some atypical combinations in 17.9 million papers.
sources.claim_limit: Citations are an impact proxy; association is not a causal instruction for invention.

sources.authors: Doshi, A. R., & Hauser, O. P.
sources.title: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
sources.read_scope: institutional original abstract and published-version metadata
sources.supported_claim: AI story ideas improved evaluated outputs while making different writers' stories more similar.
sources.claim_limit: Does not establish the same effect for engineering agents, all models or all creative tasks.

sources.authors: Silvia, P. J., Winterstein, B. P., Willse, J. T., Barona, C. M., Cram, J. T., Hess, K. I., Martinez, J. L., & Richard, C. A.
sources.title: Assessing creativity with divergent thinking tasks: Exploring the reliability and validity of new subjective scoring methods
sources.venue: Psychology of Aesthetics, Creativity, and the Arts, 2(2), 68–85
sources.read_scope: institutional original article abstract and opening discussion
sources.supported_claim: Evaluates subjective scoring and problems with traditional rarity-and-fluency scoring of divergent thinking.
sources.claim_limit: No rating scheme substitutes for task-specific outcome and validity evidence.

sources.authors: Edmondson, A.
sources.title: Psychological Safety and Learning Behavior in Work Teams
sources.read_scope: institutional original abstract and metadata
sources.supported_claim: Psychological safety was associated with learning behavior in 51 manufacturing teams.
sources.claim_limit: This is learning-behavior evidence, not direct universal creative-output evidence.

sources.authors: Grant, A. M., & Berry, J. W.
sources.title: The Necessity of Others Is the Mother of Invention: Intrinsic and Prosocial Motivations, Perspective Taking, and Creativity
sources.read_scope: institutional abstract; original paper opening checked for author order
sources.supported_claim: Prosocial motivation strengthened the intrinsic-motivation/creativity relationship; perspective taking mattered in the studies.
sources.claim_limit: Imagined beneficiaries are not observations of actual user needs.

sources.authors: Mednick, S. A.
sources.title: The associative basis of the creative process
sources.read_scope: original article opening and definition; indexed bibliographic metadata
sources.supported_claim: Associative account connects existing elements under requirements.
sources.claim_limit: Remote word associations do not by themselves establish useful, resource-feasible novelty.
